title: Jesus learned the resurrection technique in Egypt

tellings.quote: He goes to Egypt. He understands the resurrection technique here

plain: Jesus went to Egypt and learned a "resurrection technique" there, according to the writer Whitley Strieber, who says he has met nonhuman beings himself. Strieber offers this as his own reading, drawing on the book Jesus: A New Vision and on the Gospel of Thomas, an ancient collection of sayings attributed to Jesus that is not in the Bible. If he is right, rising from the dead would be a skill Jesus was taught, not a one-off miracle.
